why_relevant: Trade-press personalia column dedicated to the Czech banking/insurance sector; the most sector-precise people-moves ledger found. Confirmed to carry dated items such as Radka Turková joining the National Development Bank board, Slavomír Beňa taking over J&T Banka, ČBA electing Aleš Blažek, Martin Vašek at AČSS.

Consumer-finance portal running a standing 'personálie' stream covering banks, insurers and building societies (e.g. Raiffeisenbank SME head Roman Herman; NN Životní pojišťovna; ČSOB board expansion with Karin Van Hoecke).

Standing topic page collecting Czech financial-sector personnel changes; also republishes company press releases (Partners Banka CEO change, Privatbanka COO/CFO hires), which gives an early, unfiltered signal alongside journalistic coverage.
Cross-sector Czech management-news outlet with a dedicated, paginated personnel-changes section; useful for catching bank and payments appointments that the big dailies skip.
Finance-function trade title with a careers stream; the best channel for CFO / finance-director moves inside Czech banks and payment companies, a layer the general press under-covers.

source_name: MediaGuru.cz — Personální změny v marketingu, reklamě a PR
why_relevant: A maintained, year-by-year running ledger of Czech marketing/communications personnel changes — consistently captures bank CMO and communications-director moves (Air Bank marketing head Oldřich Dostál departing; ČSOB marketing director Jiří Jón; Komerční banka brand/communication team restructuring). Marketing-leadership churn is an early indicator of bank strategy and reorganisation.

Czech business weekly/portal that writes analytical pieces on the fintech and banking sector (e.g. 'Rozpuštěný a vypuštěný fintech' on fintechs folding into banks) — useful for the organisational-change and consolidation angle behind people moves.

Economy weekly from the HN stable; long-form profiles and sector analyses that explain why an executive left and what the reorganisation is for — the interpretive layer above the wire-style personalia items.

Investigative subscriber-funded daily; publishes leaked-document banking stories (e.g. leaked documents on a post-Soviet bank's management reacting to its Czech exit) and executive-downfall reporting. Low volume but high value for exits nobody announces.

Investment portal carrying market-moving corporate news for listed issuers, incl. Komerční banka and Erste/Moneta — board changes at listed banks surface here as timestamped 'hot news' items faster than in the general press.

A literal 'who moved where' column for the Czech IT/tech industry; covers CIO/CTO and digital-banking technology appointments that banking desks miss — relevant given bank restructurings are increasingly IT-cost driven.
Czech Radio's public-service news tag on banking — open access, no paywall, and a useful free confirmation layer for moves and layoffs first reported behind HN/Deník N paywalls.
Secondary Czech news outlet covering central-bank and financial leadership stories; adds breadth and an independent editorial line for cross-checking single-source claims.
Smaller Czech finance news site that nonetheless reported specific ČNB expert departures (Dana Hájková) — useful long-tail for sub-board-level moves that only matter in aggregate.

source_name: Hays Czech Republic — Mzdový průzkum / Salary Guide
why_relevant: Annual salary guide covering ~12 specialisations and ~400 positions incl. banking/finance, with per-sector forward-looking hiring commentary. Bilingual (EN mirror at /en/salary-guide). Core weak-signal source on which financial-services functions are in demand and at what pay level.

source_name: Hays Czech Republic — Kalkulačka mezd (salary calculator)
why_relevant: Interactive per-position salary bands derived from the Hays survey; lets one pull banking/finance role benchmarks without the gated PDF, and track band drift between editions.

source_name: Hays Executive Czech Republic (executive search practice pages)
why_relevant: Executive-search practice page and associated thought-leadership signal which senior financial-services mandates and leadership skill profiles are being sought in CZ.

source_name: Grafton Recruitment CZ — Mozaika pracovního trhu / mzdový průzkum
why_relevant: Grafton's salary survey maps wages across nine sectors and CZ regions; 'Mozaika pracovního trhu' adds employer-vs-employee expectation gaps. Strong aggregate hiring-direction signal for finance/shared-services roles that banks staff in Prague/Brno/Ostrava.

source_name: ManpowerGroup CZ — Index trhu práce (Employment Outlook Survey, MEOS)
why_relevant: Quarterly net employment outlook broken out by sector including 'Finance, pojišťovnictví a nemovitosti' / 'Finance and Insurance' — a leading quantitative indicator of CZ financial-sector hiring intent, published ~one quarter ahead of actual headcount.
Archive hub for all Manpower CZ studies (talent shortage, upskilling, productivity). Acts as a pointer into individual reports naming scarce functions relevant to banks (risk, compliance, data, IT).

source_name: Randstad Česká republika — Průzkum mezd a benefitů / Workmonitor / REBR
source_subtype: recruiter survey suite / employer brand research
why_relevant: Three recurring CZ instruments: salary & benefits survey, Workmonitor (employee sentiment, n≈500 CZ), and Employer Brand Research (which employers are attractive — banks feature heavily). Useful for talent-attraction position of individual CZ banks.
Free CZ salary guide comparing average salaries and benefits by function; a second independent benchmark to triangulate Hays/Grafton banking-role bands.

source_name: Amrop Czech Republic (Amrop Jenewein / Dr. Kaufmann & Partner, Prague office)
why_relevant: Retained executive-search firm with a Prague office and board-services practice; publishes leadership studies and announces senior placements — a route to leadership-move signals in CZ banking/insurance before company press releases.

source_name: Boyden Czech Republic — financial services practice
source_subtype: executive search firm site / practice insights
why_relevant: Boyden runs a dedicated global financial-services practice and has had a CZ presence for 20+ years; its CZ partner pages and thought-leadership indicate which banking/insurance leadership mandates are active.

source_name: Stanton Chase Prague — leadership advisory / financial services
why_relevant: Third global retained-search brand with a Prague office; adds coverage of senior CZ financial-services mandates and periodic leadership/compensation commentary.

The main CZ HR trade portal (self-described first CZ news portal for managers and HR, ~18k articles, large LinkedIn group). Republishes recruiter surveys, LMC/Jobs.cz labour data and HR-vendor press releases — a high-yield pointer to the whole recruiter-publication layer.
Independent CZ HR magazine with a dedicated 'trh práce' section; smaller than HR News but carries recruiter commentary and labour-market pieces, useful as a redundancy pointer.

source_name: HRforum.cz — People Management Forum / Asociace personalistů ČR
why_relevant: The largest CZ HR association (founded 1993), publishes HR Forum magazine 6x/year and runs Fórum zaměstnanosti and HR Gala events whose programmes and press releases name which sectors (incl. banking) are debating hiring strategy. Conference speaker lists are a cheap map of bank HR directors.

source_name: Svaz personalistů ČR — Novinky ze světa HR
why_relevant: Second CZ HR-professional body aggregating HR news; low volume but occasionally carries recruiter/sector items not picked up by HR News.

source_subtype: salary database / job portal data product
why_relevant: Continuously updated crowd/vendor salary database with a dedicated 'bankovnictví' branch and per-role pages (e.g. finanční analytik). Higher refresh rate than annual recruiter guides; useful for pay-drift tracking on specific bank roles.
